answer_as_filed: Knox Community Hospital uses 340B funds to keep our doors open.  We use the funds to supplement the budget our Case Management department has to assist patients in paying for medications and durrable medical equipment.  We use it to pay our staff so that we can continue to safely care for our patients.  Since 2020, our facility has been in a financial decline.  We have seen an increase in uncompensated care. Our cost for charity care in 2025 was and insured patients in 2025 was over 3 million dollars.  As the only healthcare facility of our kind in Knox County, being able to keep our doors open so that people can receive the care they need locally is everything.
